rules.text: Major appliances at Lowe's Outlet Locations must be returned within 48 hours of purchase if they have mechanical or electrical damage or defects.
rules.quote: Lowe’s Outlet Locations will only accept returns for major appliances* items with mechanical or electrical damage or defects that deem the appliance non-functional. These items must be returned within 48 hours after taking possession of the item.

rules.text: Some items can be returned within 30 days of purchase.
rules.quote: You can return these items within 30 days of purchase:

rules.text: Some items can be returned within 48 hours of purchase.
rules.quote: You can return these items within 48 hours of purchase:

rules.text: Most new, unused merchandise can be refunded or exchanged with receipt within 90 days of the original purchase date unless noted otherwise.
rules.quote: Most new, unused merchandise can be refunded or exchanged with receipt within 90 days of the original purchase date, unless noted in our [Return Policy Exceptions](https://www.lowes.com#ExpandedReturnPolicy).

rules.text: Some items can be returned within 365 days of purchase.
rules.quote: You can return these items within 365 days of purchase:

rules.text: A valid proof of purchase is required to receive a refund or in-store credit for permitted returns.
rules.quote: To receive a refund or in-store credit, you must present a valid proof of purchase with your permitted return.

rules.text: Returns with valid proof of purchase will be refunded or exchanged to the original method of payment except as otherwise set forth.
rules.quote: Returns with a valid proof of purchase will be exchanged or refunded to the original method of payment, except as set forth by the following:

rules.category: Lowe's Outlet items except major appliances with defects
rules.text: Lowe's Outlet Locations do not accept returns for cosmetic damage or insufficient size or other returns besides major appliances with defects within 48 hours.
rules.quote: Lowe’s Outlet Locations will not accept any other returns, including, but not limited to, returns for cosmetic damage or insufficient size.

rules.text: Items purchased at Lowe's Outlet may only be returned to the same Outlet and not to regular Lowe's stores; items purchased at regular Lowe's stores may not be returned to Outlets.
rules.quote: Items eligible for return that were purchased from a Lowe’s Outlet may only be returned to the same Outlet; they may not be returned to a regular Lowe’s retail store or a different Outlet. Items purchased at a regular Lowe’s retail store may not be returned to a Lowe’s Outlet.

rules.text: Except for permitted returns, all sales are final and may not be returned.
rules.quote: Except for permitted returns, all sales are final and may not be returned.
